style.styleTitle: Personalised Dog and Christmas Tree Bauble by No Ordinary Gift
style.toneOfVoice: A personalised glass Christmas bauble for any dog lover. The bauble contains a snowy scene with a little wooden dog, which is customisable from a choice of over 15 breeds, sitting next to a Christmas tree. The tree itself can be personalised with 3 lines of custom text displayed along ‘banners’ that wrap around the design of the tree. The scene inside the bauble is made from printed wooden layers and is finished with a scattering of loose artificial snow. The text for the banners will be printed exactly as it is entered in the personalisation fields on your order. The bauble measures 10 x 10cm.
